title: Liquidity Pools as Mean Field Games with Transaction Costs
summary: This paper extends the theoretical framework introduced in Liquidity Pools as Mean Field Games: A New Framework, where the interactions among traders in a constant product market-making protocol were modeled using mean field games (MFG). In this extension, transaction costs are incorporated into the traders' inventory dynamics, modeling the impact of pool fees on trading decisions. Traders operate at a mid-price adjusted for transaction costs, introducing a new dynamic for the DAI inventory.
